cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to leave space around furniture. Was this sofa always in front of the cupboard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remembered one part. Did making that space involve somebody moving the sofa?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, I moved it. I put your mugs somewhere easier to reach.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're finally thinking ahead. Would that be the sock drawer, or is there another storage method I haven't taught you yet?
